name: Metusael
title: Descendant of Cain
summary: Metusael was a descendant of Cain and the father of Lamek in Cain's lineage. He is mentioned in Genesis 4 as part of the Cainite genealogy. He should not be confused with Methushelah (Methuselah), who belongs to Seth's lineage and became the oldest man in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Cain's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Metusael is mentioned as the son of Mehujael and the father of Lamek in Cain's lineage, a genealogy that traces the development of the first civilization after the Fall.

keyEvents.title: Cain's Lineage Established
keyEvents.description: Metushael is part of the continuous lineage from Cain, showing how humanity developed after Cain was driven away from God's presence.

keyEvents.title: Father of Lamech
keyEvents.description: Metushael became the father of Lamech, who is known for taking two wives and for his violent song of vengeance, illustrating the growing sin in Cain's line.

keyEvents.title: Part of a Civilization in Rebellion
keyEvents.description: Cain's descendants, including Metushael, represent a line that developed culture and technology but moved further away from God.
